reviews.comment:
No me gusta que jueguen con el gatillo del surtidor. Lo hacen para perjudicar al que va a cargar combustible, parece que cuesta mucho ser honesto. No sé cómo es la trampa pero la hay, te carga menos. ESO NO SE HACE, algunos ganamos el dinero trabajando y actitudes como esas nos afectan. Se merecen una sola estrella.

(Translated by Google)
I don't like it when they tamper with the pump trigger. They do it to cheat the customer; it seems being honest is so hard. I don't know how the trick works, but there is one—they pump less gas. THAT'S NOT OKAY. Some of us earn our money through hard work, and attitudes like that affect us. They deserve only one star.
